what: An install holds the supervisor's lock through uv sync, so every call to every running app waits for it, including the node's kill path, and for ever with known-2
The hook runs a bare python, so it works only if the first python on the CLI's PATH is the host's environment
A reinstall adds new disabled triggers on every published version and can write the shipped draft over an edited draft head
The settings.memory.scopes key in template definitions is read by no engine code
14 price series fed whole bars never hold a slot, and check stays green
_Core.timer builds exits on the long side only, so a repair that only feeds evidence gives shorts exits that never fire
The copilot's qml_run row can never succeed, because no code fills ctx.bots
materialise copies a sealed month into any folder it is given
A host keeps the first records it compiled against for its whole life
A study's holdout cannot name a real holdout, because the schema types it as a plain string
Every job labels fidelity bars while the run replays quotes
A run on a fixture says nothing, because gather's warnings are dropped in LanderLibrary._compiled
A 30 second stall stops the trading node for good, because call runs self.stop on a tool timeout and a stopped app stays down
Bars the node records cannot be read as bars, because no product code calls append_series, so the MIS on a node machine finds nothing
real_bearer ignores UserName
One deployment naming a symbol the broker does not list kills the whole account after a restart
The reconcile row writes the node's memory under venue_stop
A stop he moves by hand in cTrader is never read
A stop fired while the process is down leaves an entry with no exit and no alarm
_absorb ignores ProtoOAAccountDisconnectEvent, ProtoOATraderUpdatedEvent and ProtoOASymbolChangedEvent
